requirement: The command-line tool shall read interval ECDLP problem definitions from ASCII files containing hexadecimal values and compressed or uncompressed public keys, and search for solutions on SECP256K1 using Pollard's kangaroo algorithm. Operators shall be able to configure distinguished-point sizing to trade memory consumption against computational overhead.

The system shall save search progress at a configurable interval, optionally include kangaroo state, allow inspection of saved work files, and resume a search without the original input file. Saved work for the same target key and search range shall remain resumable and mergeable across different hardware and distinguished-point or kangaroo-count settings.

The system shall merge two or more compatible work files offline into consolidated search state, including files produced by distributed runs, and report a solution if one is discovered during merging.

The system shall provide a split-backup mode that saves collected search work to separate files at each backup and resets the in-memory hash table after each save to limit its growth during computation.

The system shall support distributed execution with a server configured from a file and one or more clients connecting to a specified server. Operators shall be able to configure the server's backup interval and distinguished-point setting and enable GPU computation on clients.
